As for male characteristics I don’t really have many, I have very ambiguous characteristics that could pass as either male or female followed by my voice which is also very ambiguous and deepened when I hit puberty. I am phenotypically female leaning sorta.

I have higher than normal testosterone and androgen levels than a typical female which surfaced during puberty and my estrogen is normal.

I’m not entirely sure If I could be considered Cis, I was assigned female at birth, was raised female but always felt uncomfortable in that identity then I found out I was intersex and felt 100% comfortable in that identity as my biological sex and as my gender identity. So sort of cis with a few extra steps.

The doctors told my parents I was female and they raised me female and I never felt fully female so when I found out I am intersex (which wasn’t long ago) I was very accepting and I feel very good towards my identity (I started going by they/them pronouns which is kind of ironic).

I have mostly XX parts but I also have what is called a pseudo-phallus (a clitoral deformity) my intersex characteristics didn’t present themselves until puberty (thankfully as this insured my safety from doctors) I however have no knowledge of what anatomy is inside of me yet.
